attorneys: Irvin Goldstein for petitioners. Solicitor General Sobeloff was on the stipulation for the United States. With him on a brief in opposition to the petition were Assistant Attorney General Holland, Ellis N. Slack, John H. Mitchell, Joseph M. Howard and Dickinson Thatcher.

opinions.text: *801On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. August 9, 1955. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
